summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market purchases under its previously announced share buyback programme between 17 and 23 September 2026. The bank bought 10,900,000 ordinary shares across XMAD, CEUX, TQEX and AQEU at weighted average prices of roughly EUR 12.59 to EUR 12.97, bringing cumulative cash spent to EUR 696.8 million, about 38.2% of the programme's maximum investment amount and approximately 18.3% of shares outstanding as of 2021. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date is stated; watch execution pace and any acceleration or suspension of the programme.
